summary: Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share. The dividend is payable on June 11, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 19, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return (beyond regular dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The filing contains no terms indicating a special situation.
